concept.title: Meeting people nearby
concept.shortdesc: The Nearby tab lists the people around you who have open, with the people you have the most in common with at the top.

section.title: The status line
section.p: The top of Nearby tells you what the app is doing.

strow.stentry: How many people with open your phone can see.
No one is in range. People appear when they're within about 30 metres with open.
Shown after 90 seconds with nobody found. Phones only find each other while the app is open on both of them.

section.title: What a card shows
section.p: Each person appears as a card with:

ul.li: A status chip: You said hi, Said hi to you, Matched, or Connected.
How many interests you share, plus a match percentage when it's 20% or more.
Up to three of your shared interests by name.
How close they are, in words only. You never see a distance or a map.

strow.stentry: Your phones are connected right now.
Seen recently, but not in the last minute.

section.p: A card that reads Someone nearby with Getting their profile… is a person your phone found whose profile hasn't arrived yet. A card that reads Someone with an older version belongs to a person who needs to update before you can say hi.

section.title: Who appears first
section.p: People with the most shared interests come first, then the closest, then the most recently seen. People you haven't matched with drop off the list 30 minutes after they were last seen.
